# AERIS

> Autonomous Emergency Response & Green Corridor System (SIH-26205)
> Team Port2Code

AERIS dispatches ambulances through preempted green corridors, reroutes them around live traffic, and warns only the drivers ahead of the ambulance in its specific lane.

## Module summaries

- Home: live backend health, navigation to each module.
- Emergency Vehicle HUD: live ambulance telemetry, route, and signal preemption sequence.
- Traffic Control Dashboard: active green corridors, live preemptions, watchdog overrides.
- Citizen Reporting: file hazard reports, upload photos, corroborate reports.

## Tech stack

- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, React Router, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Vite.
- Backend: FastAPI, Motor (async MongoDB), Pydantic v2, SlowAPI rate limiting, passlib JWT auth, scikit-learn road risk model.
- External APIs: Mappls (routing/traffic/geocoding), Firebase Cloud Messaging (push alerts).

## Setup

See the README at the repository root for backend, frontend, MongoDB, and Redis prerequisites and run instructions.
